column1: # UNGRADABLE.tsv -- snoflake_suite: shipped fixtures that CANNOT be graded, each named with the reason
# MEASURED against the oracle. THE PACKAGE LOCKDOWN (Lon 2026-09-06). Written coo 2026-09-08.
# ⛔ THIS FILE MIRRORS OUTSIDE_SPITBOL_BASELINE.tsv beside it, one row for one row, as the csnobol4
# runner already does (test_snobol4_csnobol4_suite.sh line 53). That file says how the fixture was
# classified; this one is the lockdown bucket that keeps the four inventory numbers summing to shipped.
# Edit them together or they drift apart.
# ⛔ EVERY REASON HERE IS ORACLE-SIDE ONLY, and that is enforced: lib_inventory.sh REFUSES(2) an
# UNGRADABLE row whose reason names our own compiler, because "we cannot grade it" is a statement about
# us and never a property of the fixture. It caught the first draft of this file, which said what SCRIP
# does beside what sbl -bf does; the SCRIP half is recorded in OUTSIDE_SPITBOL_BASELINE.tsv instead.
# Class ORACLE_REFUSES passes the admission test -- overturnable for the WHOLE class at once, the day
# sbl -bf answers these, not one file at a time.
